changes.reason: Describe bounded Azure Properties callback model correspondence and explicitly unmodeled transport/header/authorization/liveness boundaries.

Live HEAD Properties lifecycle publishes only a successful current request; clears old values on Open/Close and ignores stale completion/finalization. Bound component abstraction; actual header parsing, transport and authorization need separate native browser checks.

models.limits: Bounded component-callback/state abstraction, not JS/Go/SQL refinement or full Azure authorization. Context is captured lifecycle identity, not invented scope equality check. Root remount and component destruction abstracted; no epoch reuse/unbounded wraparound, header parsing/UTF8/arithmetic/HTML proof, cryptographic/transport proof or liveness. Callable Open can be programmatically invoked on completed pane; not claim background controls clickable through native dialog. Native helper raw HTTP != official SDK; container properties deferred.
